input.deconvolution: Green channel of exported TIFF, deterministic blend and impulse masks; not a capture of internal Lab data
input.resize: Three planar FP32 channels converted from exported RGB16 TIFF

method.scope: Operation benchmarks, not full export or editor responsiveness
method.order: Rotates cpu/opencl/cuda per run, seven runs per case; first excluded from medians and retained in samples
method.timed: Packing, allocations, transfers, execution, host output validation and commit. Resident resize excludes source upload but includes output download.
method.excluded: TIFF decoding, oracle computation, input reset and comparison against CPU
method.startup: First OpenCL use includes program build/context. Driver compiler caches were not cleared.
method.execution: Sequential without concurrent build/export; final table uses system_opencl_loader
method.memory_field: device_bytes is populated only for GPU resize; zero elsewhere means not reported

validation.opencl_tests: 4/4 passed with system ICD loader and CUDA-free build
validation.no_device: Empty ICD directory via OCL_ICD_VENDORS; output unchanged
validation.opencl_device_memory_sanitizer: Not run; CUDA Compute Sanitizer results from previous steps do not validate OpenCL

integration: Standalone tools/opencl-tests; no OpenCL dispatch in ART editor/CLI
